summary: Iter-17: Full validation of (1) smart per-device+IP login throttling, (2) activity-log Excel export, (3) activity-log delete authorization. Backend: 9/9 PASS at /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_throttle_and_logs.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter17.xml). Verified: (a) POST /auth/login with non-existent email qa-nobody@example.com + device_id qaDev1 — 1st wrong → 401 (no wait tail since wait<4s), immediate retry → 429 with 'Çok fazla hatalı deneme. 2 saniye sonra tekrar deneyin.' Parsed wait=2s, slept, retried → 401 with detail containing exactly '4 saniye' (next-backoff hint). (b) Same IP but device_id qaDev2 → 401 not 429 (device key is isolated). (c) Correct admin login with pre-registered device qaDev3 succeeds → 200 token+user, confirming smart throttle does NOT lock the whole account across devices. (d) /activity-logs/export with mode:'ids' (seeded QA logs), mode:'all' (as Murat non-admin — allowed), mode:'range' with ISO start+end — all return 200 xlsx with EXACT header row ['Tarih / Saat (TSİ)','Kullanıcı','İşlem','Bölüm','Detay'] and correct row counts. mode:'range' with no dates → 400 'Tarih aralığı belirtilmedi'. (e) /activity-logs/delete as Murat → 403 (require_admin). As Özkan with mode:'ids' on freshly-seeded QA- logs → 200 {deleted:2}, DB verification confirms rows gone. Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080, device_id locked to qaDev3 pre-registered to avoid new-device emails): • Özkan /islem-gunlugu: log-export-btn visible with ' Excel'e Aktar (53)' label; click triggers islem-gunlugu-2026-10-15.xlsx download. Typing 'login' into log-search changes label to (35) → export count IS tied to filter. Delete toolbar + select-all + per-row trash icons all visible. Checking a row then clicking log-delete-selected-btn opens log-confirm-dialog with log-confirm-export button labelled 'Önce Excel olarak indir' — clicking it downloads xlsx WITHOUT closing dialog; clicking log-confirm-cancel closes it without deleting. • Murat /islem-gunlugu: log-export-btn visible with (54) count; log-delete-toolbar, log-select-all, and ALL log-delete-* elements have count=0 — non-admin UI correctly stripped. Cleanup: deleted all qaDev* devices, cleared login_throttle, purged login_attempts/failed_logins for test emails, removed all QA-TEST activity_logs. DB verified empty of test artifacts. No real-account password/email mutations; wrong-password attempts used only non-existent email so no security-alert emails to real inboxes. IP-level throttle counter stayed under FREE_FAILS=10 (only 2 wrong attempts on IP from this test machine).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _throttle_fail: wait seconds use 2**n with n=fails-free_fails. For the device key (free=0), 1st fail → wait=2s (2^1). The spec says sequence 2s,4s,8s... max 15 min. Code gives 2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512 (THROTTLE_MAX=900 only kicks after 2^10=1024). So at 9 consecutive device fails cumulative wait exceeds 15 minutes real-time anyway. Matches spec intent.

server.py login error message formatting (line 547): detail wraps the wait hint only when wait>=4 (second fail onwards). Produces 'E-posta veya şifre hatalı. Yeni deneme için 4 saniye bekleyin.' — clear and user-friendly. Note the leading period+space format is consistent.
server.py _throttle_wait reads ALL throttle docs for the provided keys and returns max wait. Both the dev-key and ip-key waits are considered — correct smart-throttle semantics.

server.py activity-logs/export is NOT admin-gated (uses get_current_user). This is INTENTIONAL per spec (Murat can also export). Confirmed: Murat gets 200 on mode:'all' export. However export permits arbitrary callers to pull ALL activity logs including Özkan's actions and auth events — fine within this app's threat model (both users are trusted employees) but worth noting.

ConfirmDeleteDialog.jsx: 'Önce Excel olarak indir' button is placed OUTSIDE AlertDialogFooter and ABOVE the footer — layout works but renders as a lone button on left; consider wrapping in the footer or a dedicated section with explanatory copy for clarity.

ActivityLog.jsx exportLogs() builds filename using toISOString().slice(0,10) which is UTC date. On late-night TSİ (TR UTC+3) the user may see yesterday's date in the filename after 21:00 TR. Low priority — functionality unaffected.

server.py login throttle: on correct password, delete_many clears BOTH the device key AND the ip key for this (ip, device_id) pair. If another device at the same IP was accumulating fails (ip-key fails > IP_THROTTLE_FREE_FAILS=10), a successful login on ANY device at that IP wipes the IP-level penalty. Could be a bypass vector in multi-tenant NAT scenarios — probably intentional for small-office use.
